contentHtml:
v4.6.3 is the next patch release.

👉 Changelog

compare changes

🚨 Security fixes

  • vite: do not read files named in client error reports (63299e13c) - GHSA-x287-wcfc-q46c
  • vite: deny dev server access to nitro dev output (c7e204ec6) - GHSA-648h-gw55-m2g7
  • vite: deny serving generated app secret in dev (16dfdc2a9) - GHSA-3xf4-9g3c-4h4w
  • nitro,nuxt: handle dot segments in request paths (440250d97) - GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv33
  • nuxt: apply redirect route rules to page islands (b20372dbe) - GHSA-2fxj-c3j7-rr69

🔥 Performance

  • vite: skip compiling plain style blocks in the server build (#36711)
  • nitro,nuxt,rspack,webpack: bundle esm vue + reuse caches (#36710)
  • vite: avoid quadratic nested dir check for fs.allow (#36702)
  • nuxt: server render internal custom links without RouterLink (#36707)
  • nuxt: skip unneeded typed routes generation (#36645)

🩹 Fixes

  • nitro: don't share prerender hints with self-fetched requests (#36705)
  • nuxt: defer app scope cleanup on external navigation (#36713)
  • nuxt: prevent useCookie CookieStore sync from rewriting with refresh (#36673)
  • nuxt: only return redirects from navigateTo while middleware runs (#36650)
  • nuxt: remove purged entries from _asyncData (#36709)
  • vite: skip quoted import.meta keys + limit replace to client dev (#36703)
  • nuxt: hide RouteLocationRaw from navigateTo's public return type (#36691)
  • nuxt: tree-shake auto-imported #app composables (#36696)
  • nuxt: don't treat constrained route rules as covering dynamic pages (#36701)
  • nuxt: include shared/ in build cache hash (#36704)
  • nuxt: hash keyed function ids + page import names relative to rootDir (#36697)
  • nuxt: encode page paths before matching route rule keys (#36683)
  • nuxt: handle rejected updateCallbackDone of aborted view transition (#36639)
  • ui-templates: keep loading shader proportions on narrow screens (#36654)
  • nuxt: reject case-dependent route rule constraints w/ sensitive: false (#36708)
  • nuxt: don't case-fold regex constraints in route rule keys (#36694)
  • nuxt: normalise page prefix when finding route rule exceptions (#36685)
  • vite: mirror ssr invalidations for created and deleted files (634cba64c)
  • nitro: keep noScripts wildcard patterns single-segment (fa323db7d)
  • deps: update unrouting to v0.3.1 (#36663)
  • nuxt: avoid self-referencing nuxt/schema augmentation (#36633)
  • nuxt: let nightly runtime resolve its own nuxt/* imports (#36632)
  • nuxt: don't warn for vite+ vite.config files (#36628)
  • kit: keep generated declaration first in tsconfig include (#36627)
  • nuxt: clamp numeric v-for sources in island renders at render time (#36623)
  • rspack,webpack: register vue-loader plugin only once per config (#36622)
  • nitro: abort the portable request when the client disconnects (#36652)
  • deps: update nitropack to 2.13.5 + drop obsolete workarounds (#36649)

📖 Documentation

  • note provide/inject limit in server components (#35837)
  • use American spelling in a few guides (#36706)
  • document controlling prefetch hints via build:manifest hook (#36695)
  • update StackBlitz link to point to version 4 (#36674)
  • link to the 2.x docs (#36640)
  • clarify that island props must be validated before iteration (4b12d15c9)

✅ Tests

  • list NUXT_B4023 as main-only (4fd54ff9a)
  • wait for leave transition before each scroll behaviour test (453406999)
  • vite: assert spa server bundle does not ship the app (#36699)
  • nuxt: cover route rule coverage under a base url (#36682)
  • list NUXT_B9006 as main-only (e107e0f40)

🤖 CI

  • only run full checks for the last merge queue entry (132698a46)
  • run a reduced matrix in the merge queue (7d228ba4b)
  • compare merge queue changes against the base branch (bad8c3637)
  • notify resolved issues after publishing a release (9d47884f3)
  • remove broken ai-moderator and ecosystem-ci trigger workflows (1d89ad434)
